_comment: EXAMPLE corpus registry. Each key is '<database>/<container>' (most specific), or just '<container>', or '<database>' (a DB-wide default). Copy this file, replace every <PLACEHOLDER> with your own values, and point CORPUS_REGISTRY_FILE at your copy. API keys are NEVER stored here: 'embed_api_key_env' / 'cosmos_key_env' name the environment variables that hold them. Two labelled entries follow: a FULL end-to-end example (every supported field) and a MINIMAL one (only what's needed).

your_database/full_example_container.embed_query_instruction: Given a question, retrieve documents that answer it
